item.title: Running Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU Passthrough
item.description: Set up Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU passthrough, Tailscale access and Open WebUI. Run local LLMs with GPU acceleration on your own hardware.

item.title: How to Expand an Ubuntu LVM Logical Volume to Use All Free Space on the PV
item.description: Expand an Ubuntu LVM logical volume to use all free space on the physical volume with lvextend and resize2fs, when the root partition fills up.

item.title: How To call a bash command with variables in Python
item.description: Call a bash command with variables from Python 3 using subprocess.run: list arguments, captured output, exit codes and when shell=True is safe. Tested on 3.14.

item.title: How to check if RAM is running in ECC mode
item.description: Check whether your RAM is running in ECC mode on Windows and Linux using dmidecode or WMIC, for servers and workstations.

item.title: How To: Raspberry Pi boot from USB
item.description: Boot a Raspberry Pi 4 from an external SSD over USB by updating the EEPROM bootloader. Faster and more reliable than an SD card.

item.title: How to upgrade Ubuntu from 18.04 to 20.04
item.description: Upgrade Ubuntu 18.04 LTS to 20.04 LTS in-place using do-release-upgrade. Preserve installed packages and configuration during a major release upgrade.

item.title: Setup the Nextcloud Snap Package with HTTPS and a separate data path
item.description: Install the Nextcloud snap on Ubuntu with Let's Encrypt HTTPS and a separate data mount on an external drive, with automatic certificate renewal.

item.title: Kali Linux 2020.1 - No more root by default
item.description: Kali Linux 2020.1 drops root as the default user. What the change means for penetration testing workflows and how sudo is configured in the new setup.

item.title: Clipboard and Shared Folders on Kali Linux with VirtualBox
item.description: Enable clipboard sync and shared folders for Kali Linux in VirtualBox by installing virtualbox-guest-x11.

item.title: [SOLVED] - Running Docker on a Raspberry Pi 4
item.description: Fix Docker install errors on a Raspberry Pi 4 running Raspbian Buster. Resolves the kernel cgroup issue that stops containers starting on ARM boards.

item.title: Debian 9 - Running a python script at boot
item.description: Run a Python script automatically at boot on Debian with crontab @reboot, pass parameters, redirect output and check it started with journalctl.

item.description: Install a newer Python on Debian, Ubuntu or Kali without breaking apt: python-is-python3, uv, the deadsnakes PPA, or make altinstall from source. Tested October 2026.
